title: Punctured log Gromov-Witten theory of log modifications and double ramification cycles with target log variety
summary: We expand upon a previous study conducted by the author on the behavior of punctured log Gromov-Witten theory under log étale modifications $\widetilde{X} \rightarrow X$, giving expressions for log Gromov-Witten classes on $\widetilde{X}$ in terms of log Gromov-Witten classes on $X$, facilitating a complete reduction of the punctured log Gromov-Witten theory of any modification $\widetilde{X}$ of an snc log scheme $X$ to the punctured log Gromov-Witten theory of $X$.
